title: Feasibility of Addressing Sexual Dysfunction in Women with Breast and Gynecologic Cancers with a Novel Mobile Application
official: Not Always ROSY-Feasibility of Addressing Sexual Dysfunction in Women with Breast and Gynecologic Cancers with a Novel Mobile Application
summary: The purpose of this study is to identify breast and gynecologic cancer patients with sexual dysfunction, to measure sexual dysfunction with the Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) and to provide Patients with the opportunity during this six-month period to follow up with a healthcare provider to discuss the sexual dysfunction needs and to see if a medical intervention can be of aid.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with a current or historic diagnosis of breast cancer or gynecologic cancer (uterine ovarian, fallopian tube, peritoneal, cervical, vulva, or vaginal cancers)
* Agree to participate in the study with completion of survey and use of ROSY mobile application

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently pregnant
* Non-English speaking (ROSY is currently is only available is in English).
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston
